html:Et forældrekøb er, når forældre køb: A parental purchase is when parents buy a home and rent it out to their child, typically during their studies. For tax purposes, it's letting of real property. You own the flat, you receive the rental income, and you deduct the expenses. The child is a tenant with an ordinary tenancy agreement.
